items.title: Is Micron a Buy After Its Latest Explosive Earnings Report? Here Are the Bull and Bear Cases.
items.summary: Micron Technology has surged 270% this year driven by strong AI demand for memory and storage, with fiscal Q4 revenue up over 300% to $54 billion and gross margins at 86%. The bull case highlights early-stage AI adoption, strategic customer agreements through 2031, and continued growth potential. The bear case warns of cyclical memory pricing pressures as supply doubles by 2028, potential AI spending slowdowns, and risks of a pullback despite attractive 6x forward earnings valuation.
